classification: Infrastructure pickup observation only; no product/full-CI correctness or speed qualification
pairOrder: Sequential waves; both members share max completion of actual preceding dependencies; declaration order slim/latest,latest/slim,slim/latest

originalVerify.verbatimScript:
if [ "$CODE_PATHS" != "success" ]; then
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$SHOULD_RUN" != "true" ]; then
  echo "Docs-only change; expensive PR checks skipped."
fi
failed=0
check_job() {
  local name="$1" result="$2" should="$3"
  if [ "$should" = "true" ]; then
    if [ "$result" != "success" ]; then
      echo "$name: expected success, got $result"
      failed=1
    fi
  else
    if [ "$result" != "skipped" ]; then
      echo "$name: expected skipped, got $result"
      failed=1
    fi
  fi
}
# Require success when the PR has code-relevant changes
check_job preflight "$PREFLIGHT" "$PREFLIGHT_SHOULD_RUN"
check_job git_compatibility "$GIT_COMPATIBILITY" "$GIT_COMPATIBILITY_SHOULD_RUN"
check_job codex_index_heal_contract "$CODEX_INDEX_HEAL_CONTRACT" "$CODEX_INDEX_HEAL_CONTRACT_SHOULD_RUN"
check_job xterm_patch_sync "$XTERM_PATCH_SYNC" "$XTERM_PATCH_SYNC_SHOULD_RUN"
check_job shell_contracts "$SHELL_CONTRACTS" "$SHELL_CONTRACTS_SHOULD_RUN"
check_job test "$TEST" "$TEST_SHOULD_RUN"
check_job orcad_browser "$ORCAD_BROWSER" "$ORCAD_BROWSER_SHOULD_RUN"
check_job mobile_web_app "$MOBILE_WEB_APP" "$MOBILE_WEB_APP_SHOULD_RUN"
check_job cross-version-wire "$CROSS_VERSION_WIRE" "$CROSS_VERSION_WIRE_SHOULD_RUN"
check_job managed_hook_node18 "$MANAGED_HOOK_NODE18" "$MANAGED_HOOK_NODE18_SHOULD_RUN"
check_job package "$PACKAGE" "$PACKAGE_SHOULD_RUN"
check_job package_windows "$PACKAGE_WINDOWS" "$PACKAGE_WINDOWS_SHOULD_RUN"
exit "$failed"
originalVerify.ordinaryNeedsUnchanged: Original13 actual dependencies remain in product workflow; this separate manual diagnostic uses captured values, not fabricated full checks.

capturedEnvironmentSource.redaction: Only26 exact declared result/boolean keys copied; values strictly allowlisted. No general environment or secret values copied.

measurement.readinessTimestamp: max completed_at of all actual needs rows, independently obtained from existing root API job metadata
measurement.failures: Retain failed/cancelled/unlaunched jobs, all outcomes and raw logs; do not classify partial6 as accepted observation. Later waves run after earlier failures when anchor succeeded and run is not cancelled.
measurement.arithmetic: Readiness-to-creation,creation-to-start,readiness-to-start,setup/body/close,held runner seconds separately for each sample and pair. No new collector; root existing cached metadata orchestration derives these.

limitations: Static captured success/skipped inputs are diagnostic only, not proof of real required fullCI results.
No quota/pool-cause inference or automatic ordinary runner adoption; standard hosted labels share account concurrency.
Same-window jobs can contend; threepairs not fleetp95; retain earlier3secondslim counterexample.
Manifest is source/tree/publisher-bound before launch; evaluator does not checkout/load it.
